claim: Two new additions, both confirmed working: (1) fig03 gained a 5th subpanel (p4): a 2D UMAP embedding (correlation distance, RXRR full-trial per-unit firing traces) of S++/S+/S-/S--/O+/Other units, silhouette=0.039 vs a 1000-shuffle label-permutation null, P=0.0010 -- real but modest separation, driven mainly by S++ and S-- forming visually distinct clusters; S+/S-/O+ overlap more with Other. (2) fig04 gained a new supplement (fig04xx): V1/V2, MT/MST, FEF/PFC TFR spectrograms for two pooled context groups (stim=RRRR+AAAB+BBBA, omission=RXRR+AXAB+BXBA), confirmed correct via visible gamma burst absent exactly at the omitted p2 slot, and visually consistent with fig05's frontal low-gamma finding in FEF/PFC via a completely independent pooling scheme.
notes: "Null" renamed to "Other" project-wide for the functional-group label (S+/S-/O+/Other), across fig03/fig06/fig07 source code and already-computed outputs (relabeled in place, not recomputed -- pure string rename, no numbers changed, verified by re-running all downstream aggregation/GLMM/figure steps and confirming identical statistics). The layer-assignment "Null" bucket (different concept, unresolved vFLIP layer) was deliberately left unchanged.

GPU checked for the UMAP task: RAPIDS cuML not installable on native Windows without WSL2; at this data scale (a few thousand units x ~190 bins) CPU UMAP runs in seconds, GPU would not have been the bottleneck. numba/numpy version conflict blocking umap-learn was fixed by upgrading numba (0.64->0.66), which downgraded numpy 2.5.0->2.4.6 as a side effect -- verified nothing else in the pipeline broke (jnwb, pandas, scipy, statsmodels, torch all still import and run correctly).

2026-08-06 follow-up (same day): O++ units (n=3) marked with red stars on the embedding, merged into the O+ color/label for the silhouette score and permutation test itself (unchanged: 0.039, P=0.0010) -- O++ is a strictly more specific claim about an O+ unit, not a separate population, same convention as panel_composition8_by_area's existing 'contains >=1 O++ unit' star flag. Also: p1 (presence-by-area) and p4 (UMAP) reassembled as a shared top row (p4 on the right) instead of each taking a full-width row, cutting the assembled fig03.svg height from 1207pt to 795pt (34%) -- confirmed by inspecting the assembled SVG's own transform coordinates (p1 at x=0, p4 at x=239, same y).

2026-08-06 whitespace pass (pure re-assembly of already-rendered panel SVGs/PNGs, no data re-analysis, per explicit instruction): p1 and 'e' (composition8_by_area) stacked in a left column (heights 100.5pt + 118.7pt at half-width, matching p4's 219.4pt almost exactly), placed beside p4 on the right, then p2/p3 stacked full-width below. Height dropped further, 795pt -> 556.8pt (total reduction from the original single-column stack: 1207pt -> 556.8pt, 54%). Done via svgassemble.assemble() calls on existing panel files (fig03_unit_census.py's main() was NOT re-run) -- fig03_unit_census.py's own assembly code should be updated to match this arrangement next time the figure is regenerated from scratch, so the improvement isn't only a hand-patched output. One leftover label NOT fixed this pass (would need a real re-run): the hand-specified schematic subpanel's legend still reads 'Null (baseline)' instead of 'Other (baseline)' -- missed in the earlier Null->Other rename since it's a hardcoded string in panel_ideal_template_schematic, not data-driven.

2026-08-06 final layout pass (still pure re-assembly, no re-analysis): moved p2 (peak-rate) into the left column alongside p1 and e (three barplots stacked), with p4 (UMAP) as a single large panel on the right spanning that full column's height, and p3 unchanged as its own full-width last row. Because svgassemble.assemble()'s ncol grid forces EQUAL column widths (which would leave a height mismatch either way given the 3-stack's combined aspect vs p4's near-square aspect), this required a custom SVG composition bypassing assemble() -- solved analytically for unequal column widths (left=184.6pt, right=279.4pt) that make both sides exactly the same height (~262pt), using svgassemble's own low-level primitives (viewbox/namespace/inner) directly. Total figure height: 386.4pt (down from 556.8pt this same day, 1207pt originally -- 68% total reduction). PNG rebuilt at 8x the pt-based layout via PIL for resolution. fig03_unit_census.py's assembly code still does not reflect ANY of these three whitespace passes -- a real re-run would regenerate the original loose layout; the custom composition script used here exists only as an ad hoc reassembly, not yet folded back into the generating script.

fig4xx pooling design (RRRR+AAAB+BBBA vs RXRR+AXAB+BXBA at the shared p2 slot) confirmed with the user before building -- simpler than the full R/A/B/slot-position realignment plan (PLAN_sliding_window_connectivity.md), which remains a separate, larger, not-yet-done follow-up.

STILL PENDING (explicitly requested, not yet built): fig5xx (5-band traces, all 10 areas, same two context groups, mean+-SEM across sessions), fig6xx (power correlation/coherence across the network, same two context groups), fig7xx (spike-field coupling: fig03 population groups' firing rate vs fig05xx's power traces, same shuffle-null procedure). fig5xx is a straightforward extension of the same condition_tfr_maps_p1d1p2d2p3 data fig4xx just used. fig6xx and fig7xx need genuinely NEW per-trial extraction (extract_condition_band_power_trials.py and extract_condition_spike_trials.py currently only cover RXRR/RRRR, not the A/B family conditions) before any correlation/coherence/shuffle-null analysis can be built on them -- a real, larger next step, not a quick addition.
